description: This file implements the core functions for an 'Object Container' component in a C-based object-oriented design, including creation, destruction, initialization, and object enrollment. It contains standard object-oriented initialization patterns in C, with functions like AnscOcoCreate, AnscOcoRemove, AnscOcoInitialize, and AnscOcoEnrollObjects.

classes.name: ANSC_OBJECT_CONTAINER_OBJECT
classes.description: The primary object implementing the container in this module, with members for context handles, object properties, and function pointers for operations.

classes.name: PANSC_COMPONENT_OBJECT
classes.description: A base class object for component objects, from which the container object inherits basic properties and functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Ansc Object Container Object, setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object, freeing memory and performing cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all necessary sub-objects for this container object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object’s member fields, setting function pointers and default values.
